name: Elegant Product Launch
tagline: Premium product launch deck with pale framed pages, thin black rules, taupe side panels, high-contrast serif typography, and refined product reveal layouts.

palette.description: Pale blush paper, dark ink rules, taupe side blocks, cream cards, sage surfaces, gold and muted red accents.

typography.style: High-contrast uppercase serif launch titles with precise geometric sans support copy.

best_for: Product launches, campaign plans, premium consumer products, brand roadshows, and polished commerce narratives.
avoid_for: Dense analytics, urgent news updates, technical architecture, or casual workshops where refined spacing would slow the story.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Elegant Product Launch
source_inspiration.notes: Independent high-fidelity HTML/CSS reconstruction based on public preview thumbnails: pale framed surfaces, thin black rules, taupe side panels, uppercase serif title treatment, and product launch layouts. No source assets are embedded.
